name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Structural goes with at most one of Otis, Pipeline, Concrete, and Laser.
Tesla, Concrete, and Drill belong to different engineers.
Concrete goes with exactly three of Watt, Civil, Bridge, and Laser.
Tesla goes with exactly two of Structural, Bridge, and Titanium.
Tesla, Tungsten, and Blowtorch belong to different engineers.
